say:1:1211315001:1.text: How can you be calmly doing research at a time like this?!
say:1:1211315001:1.source_cn: 情况紧急，你还在这里慢条斯理地搞什么研究？！

say:3:1211315002:1.text: And why not, my dear Bonnie?
say:3:1211315002:1.source_cn: 亲爱的波妮，为什么不呢？

say:4:1211315003:1.text: Wars inevitably conclude in peace, their outcomes predictable. But the pursuit of the unknown? Ah, that is where true excitement lies...
say:4:1211315003:1.source_cn: 战争最后总是会以或短或长的和平结束，结果已经在预期中。...

say:6:1211315005:1.text: Listen up! The Chainkeeper is maneuvering with the main fleet to the east. Once we deploy the small boats, they'll fire warning shots, and the main ship will steer away at full sail.
say:6:1211315005:1.source_cn: 听好。现在枷锁号正和主舰队在东边的海面周旋，我们一放下...

say:7:1211315006:1.text: Those rats from Rustport have definitely changed captains. This isn't their usual style.
say:7:1211315006:1.source_cn: 那群锈锚港的老鼠换了指挥，绝对没错，这不是他们以往的风格。

say:8:1211315007:1.text: So, those incessantly panting monkeys have finally attained some measure of wisdom. A fascinating revelation indeed.
say:8:1211315007:1.source_cn: 啊，所以那些喘个不停的猿猴启智了，这是个有趣的新发现。

say:9:1211315008:1.text: Why, pray tell, should I halt my critical experiments for such petty concerns?
say:9:1211315008:1.source_cn: 何必要为这种琐事中断我重要的实验呢？

say:10:1211315009:1.text: Uhh, you don't understand. A big battle is coming, and their captain has changed. So that brings up the question, where did their previous captain go?
say:10:1211315009:1.source_cn: 哼，大战在即，领头的却换人了。那他们之前的头儿去了哪里？

say:11:1211315010:1.text: One might assume... they are concocting some special scheme against our dear captain?
say:11:1211315010:1.source_cn: 常理来说……比如，在筹备对船长的特别计划？

say:12:1211315011:1.text: You finally understand! So stop obsessing over your little experiments. If we lose this battle, you'll end up with nothing.
say:12:1211315011:1.source_cn: 知道就好！别整天盯着实验和进展了，要是吃了败仗，你什么...

say:13:1211315012:1.text: Come with me. This isn't a suggestion; it's an order. I've thought of a way to hit that fly buzzing around the sea, but I'll need your help.
say:13:1211315012:1.source_cn: 这不是询问，是命令。跟我来，我有办法击中那只在海上乱飞...

say:14:1211315013:1.text: Quickly now, before that filthy ship ruins our captain's mood. We'll drag those escaped rats out from their corners, inch by inch...
say:14:1211315013:1.source_cn: 速战速决，别让那艘破船搅坏船长的好心情。然后我们再一寸...
